mandatory_legal_checks: Stamp Act 1899 S.17 — a promissory note MUST be stamped BEFORE or AT execution
Stamp Act 1899 S.35 proviso (a) — an unstamped promissory note CANNOT be cured by paying duty and penalty; it is permanently inadmissible
Stamp Act 1899 Sch.I Art.49 — promissory note duty is levied centrally, not under a State stamp Act
NI Act 1881 S.4 — the promise must be UNCONDITIONAL and the sum CERTAIN, or it is not a promissory note
NI Act 1881 S.80 — 18% per annum applies where no rate is stated
NI Act S.138 (dishonour as an offence) applies to CHEQUES, not to promissory notes
Limitation Act 1963 — three years; a written acknowledgment before expiry restarts time under S.18
